recentItems.title: Batman Knightfall Part 2: Knightquest - Official Trailer
recentItems.description:
Following his battle with Bane, Bruce Wayne is paralysed from the waist down, unable to continue as Batman to bring order to Gotham following the completion of Bane's mission. Jean-Paul Valley steps into the cape and cowl to defend the city and stop Bane, but his methods differ signficantly, proving to be far more violent and ruthless than Bruce. 

Based on characters from DC and the DC Comic Book Event, Batman: Knightfall by Doug Moench, Chuck Dixon, Alan Grant, Dennis O’Neil, Peter David, Jo Duffy, Jim Aparo, Graham Nolan, Norm Breyfogle, and Jim Balent.

The voice cast stars Anson Mount as Batman/Bruce Wayne, Michael Mando as Bane, Pablo Schreiber as Jean-Paul Valley/Azrael.

Batman Knightfall Part 2 Knightquest is coming soon!

recentItems.title: Silent Hill: Townfall - All Endings Explained (Spoilers)
recentItems.description:
In my restless dream, I see those endings, Silent Hill: Townfall... That's right, we've delved deep into the seaside town of St. Amelia to bring you our breakdown of the Abandoned, Forever, Justice, Sci-fi-lent Hill and Dog endings. 

So, if you're looking to have Silent Hill: Townfall and its lore explained to you, no worries, because we've got you covered with what's actually going on throughout the game!

How do Simon, Zoe and Richard's stories connect? What are those CRTV signals trying to tell us? That, and more, explained in our walkthrough of what every Silent Hill: Townfall ending means.

recentItems.title: No Such Place: Official Early Access Release Date Trailer

recentItems.title: Halo and Gears of War Leadership Hit Hard in Latest Xbox Layoffs - IGN Daily Fix
recentItems.description:
In today's Daily Fix:
The dust has barely settled after yesterday's seismic news of another major shake-up at Xbox. Leadership positions at Halo Studios and Gears of War developer The Coalition have taken a hit. Juan Vaca, story director for Gears of War: E-Day has been let go, just under a week before the game was set to launch on early access. And Josh Daniels, Cinematic Director for Halo, was promoted and then laid off in the same week. Layoffs at Halo Studios are not too surprising as Xbox is giving Activision the keys to Halo, but job losses at The Coalition are concerning considering Microsoft has not made any announcements about that studio. And in related news, Xbox is set to debut a new achievement: the mythic achievement, which will be their equivalent to a PlayStation platinum trophy. The sound of the new achievement has already been discovered.

recentItems.title: Silent Hill: Townfall - 8 Things To Know Before Playing
recentItems.description:
At first glance, Silent Hill Townfall may look like your average Silent Hill game, just with a FPS makeover. Upon experiencing the island of St. Amelia for yourself however, you’ll find that Townfall has a lot of unique elements that sets it apart from the previous entries, including the CRTV and first-person puzzles. Having said that, there are some elements to the game that would have been helpful to know going in, so here are 8 things we wish we knew before playing.
